## Purpose and Runtime
FineTune is a native macOS 15+ menu-bar audio-control application. It independently controls, boosts, routes, and equalizes application audio; manages output/input devices; and exposes hotkeys, media-key handling, HUD feedback, and URL automation. The SwiftUI app entry point is `FineTune/FineTuneApp.swift`; build/runtime configuration is in `FineTune.xcodeproj` and `FineTune/Info.plist`.

## Application Coordination and State
The app composition root initializes the menu-bar-oriented experience and connects permissions, popup visibility, media-key status, settings, and audio subsystems. Persistent/user-facing configuration is centralized in `FineTune/Settings/SettingsManager.swift`, with domain state represented by models such as `FineTune/Models/AudioApp.swift` and `FineTune/Models/AudioDevice.swift`. Coordination services isolate macOS accessibility and popup lifecycle concerns in `FineTune/Coordination/AccessibilityPermissionService.swift` and `FineTune/Coordination/PopupVisibilityService.swift`.

## Audio Capture, Processing, and Routing
`FineTune/Audio/Engine/AudioEngine.swift` is the central control-plane component for per-process audio handling. Process taps are created, maintained, and removed through `FineTune/Audio/Engine/ProcessTapController.swift`, while `FineTune/Audio/Engine/AppListCoordinator.swift` aligns active/pinned/ignored app state with taps. Resilience boundaries include crash prevention, echo tracking, crossfades, and orphaned-tap cleanup (`FineTune/Audio/Engine/CrashGuard.swift`, `FineTune/Audio/Engine/CrossfadeOrchestrator.swift`, `FineTune/Audio/Engine/OrphanedTapCleanup.swift`).

Audio signal processing is separated from orchestration: EQ filters and processor execution live in `FineTune/Audio/EQ/EQProcessor.swift` and `FineTune/Audio/EQ/BiquadProcessor.swift`; gain/loudness correction and output protection live in `FineTune/Audio/Loudness/LoudnessCompensator.swift` and `FineTune/Audio/Engine/SoftLimiter.swift`.

## Device Integration and Volume Backends
Core Audio device discovery, connection/state monitoring, and volume observation are isolated under `FineTune/Audio/Monitors/AudioDeviceMonitor.swift`, `FineTune/Audio/Monitors/AudioProcessMonitor.swift`, and `FineTune/Audio/Monitors/DeviceVolumeMonitor.swift`. Device metadata and hardware operations are encapsulated by Core Audio extensions, notably `FineTune/Audio/Extensions/AudioDeviceID+Info.swift` and `FineTune/Audio/Extensions/AudioDeviceID+Volume.swift`.

FineTune selects among native hardware volume, software processing, and DDC monitor control. DDC communication is bounded in `FineTune/Audio/DDC/DDCController.swift` and `FineTune/Audio/DDC/DDCService.swift`. Bluetooth monitoring supports device connection workflows through `FineTune/Audio/Monitors/BluetoothDeviceMonitor.swift`.

## EQ Profiles and External Data
AutoEQ is a distinct profile ingestion pipeline: fetch/search and parsing occur in `FineTune/Audio/AutoEQ/AutoEQFetcher.swift` and `FineTune/Audio/AutoEQ/AutoEQParser.swift`; normalization/application are handled by `FineTune/Audio/AutoEQ/AutoEQProcessor.swift`; persisted/profile selection management is in `FineTune/Audio/AutoEQ/AutoEQProfileManager.swift`. This integrates with AutoEQ profile data and user-imported EqualizerAPO ParametricEQ text, without making the main audio engine depend directly on remote retrieval.

## Interaction Surfaces and Automation
The primary UI is a SwiftUI menu-bar popup in `FineTune/Views/MenuBarPopupView.swift`, controlled externally by `FineTune/Shortcuts/MenuBarPopupController.swift`. App/device rows and EQ controls are composed from `FineTune/Views/Rows/AppRow.swift`, `FineTune/Views/Rows/DeviceRow.swift`, and `FineTune/Views/EQPanelView.swift`. Separate settings and HUD surfaces reside in `FineTune/Views/Settings/SettingsRootView.swift` and `FineTune/Views/HUD/HUDWindowController.swift`.

Global shortcuts and media keys feed actions into the same app-volume control path via `FineTune/Shortcuts/ShortcutsRegistry.swift`, `FineTune/Audio/Keys/MediaKeyMonitor.swift`, and `FineTune/Audio/Keys/MediaKeyEventDecoder.swift`. URL-based scripting enters through `FineTune/Utilities/URLHandler.swift`.

## Platform Boundaries, Permissions, and Delivery
The app depends on macOS Core Audio/process taps, DDC-capable displays, Bluetooth services, global keyboard/media-key facilities, and Screen & System Audio Recording permission (`FineTune/Audio/Permission/AudioRecordingPermission.swift`). Accessibility permission is separately mediated for keyboard-related functionality. Entitlements are declared in `FineTune/FineTune.entitlements`.

Updates are managed through `FineTune/Utilities/UpdateManager.swift`, with release feed metadata in `appcast.xml`; CI/release automation is defined by `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `.github/workflows/release.yml`.
